title: Cache upgrade crashes on startup
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the cache (Redis) crash caused by the recent deploy introducing an incompatible config directive.
root_cause: The recent deployment of the Redis container (redis:7.5) introduced an invalid `maxmemory-policy` directive in the Redis configuration file, causing Redis to fail to start and continuously restart. This makes the cache unavailable, so the API returns 500/503 errors for product searches and health checks.
truth: A deploy upgraded Redis from 7.4 to 7.5; the new version refuses to start because the existing redis.conf uses a removed configuration directive, so the cache container crashes in a restart loop and the API cannot reach it.
check_first: inspect the API container logs and health endpoint
